brain_tasks_due_approximate_check.name: brain_tasks_due_approximate_check

brain_tasks_lease_check.name: brain_tasks_lease_check

brain_tasks_idempotency_check.name: brain_tasks_idempotency_check
brain_tasks_idempotency_check.value: ((idempotency_key IS NULL) = (idempotency_fingerprint IS NULL)) AND ((idempotency_key IS NULL) OR (char_length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 8 AND 100)) AND ((idempotency_fingerprint IS NULL) OR (idempotency_fingerprint ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text))

brain_tasks_embedding_check.name: brain_tasks_embedding_check
